data.name: A Week to Remember
data.detailed_description:
We're on Kickstarter!


About the Game

Daniel Hernandez Florez has fallen into a depressive episode following the disappearance of his boyfriend, Elliot. Nightmares of a corrupted Elliot who can't remember him haunt Daniel. Celia, gifted witch and Daniel's older sister, returns home to aid in the search. When she finally coaxes him outside, Daniel finds Elliot lost and suffering from amnesia.

With little options, Elliot goes home with the sibling duo, where each day they craft spells and take Elliot places to aid in recovering his memory.

As Daniel helps Elliot, his own memories resurface, hidden in the neglected spaces and forgotten objects around his house. Each day brings them closer to uncovering the truth, but something has made its way inside Elliot… and it's only a matter of time before it claws back out.

✧ Rich with history and witchy insight, there's much to uncover in the Hernandez Florez house.

✧ With 100+ unique ingredients and tools planned, there's more than one way to craft successful spells. 

✧ Navigate key branching conversation sections to guide the narrative and gain Elliot’s favor.

✧ With five endings, experience a spectrum of bittersweet growth and acceptance... or be condemned to abandon all hope.

Accessibility

The following features have already been implemented: Alt Text, Audio/Visual Feedback, Closed Captions, Colorblind/High Contrast Modes, Gamepad Support, Motion/Photosensitivity Controls, Readable Fonts, and more!

Extras

These extra features are planned for the full game release.

  • Achievements

  • Photo & Music Gallery

  • Companion Art/Guide Book (Kickstarter Stretch Goal)

Report System

This game includes an integrated error report system for bugs, typos, and any other issues the player may encounter. 

Disclaimer

The supernatural phenomena depicted are based in real spiritual concepts and practices. Please do not attempt to imitate these practices without expertise.

data.short_description: Help Elliot recover his memories and unlock the truth of what happened before it's too late. A Mexican-American gothic, boys' love visual novel, featuring interactive spell crafting and point-and-click exploration.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 8.1, Windows 10 and Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: x64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support
  • Memory: 600 MB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 or OpenGL compatible card
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Dual-core 2.5 GHz or better
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Direct3D 11 compatible card, 1 GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 7 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible

Minimum:

Recommended:

  • Memory: 2048 MB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.0 compatible graphics
  • Storage: 7 GB available space

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
